slides.text: A **Refugees International** assessment dated **Nov 13**, cited by Addis Standard, surveyed **452 households** in **Tigray** in August and September.
It found **six in ten** displaced households said someone had **gone to bed hungry** in the previous month.
It also found **23%** of children screened at displacement sites showed signs of **acute malnutrition**, with fuel shortages and **unpaid health workers**.
**Protect civilians, open aid access.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Addis Standard via AllAfrica, Nov 17-18, 2026 (cites Refugees Intl, Nov 13; unverified)
